rationale: Discharge each EV at its available grid-side limit across the outage to maximize critical-load energy. EV_a delivers 4 kW in each 0.5 h interval (sum 6 kWh) and EV_b delivers 6/3/3 kW (sum 6 kWh), serving min(load, fleet discharge) = 10, 7, 7 kW per interval = 12.0 kWh. Discharge drains SOC by dispatch*dt/discharge_efficiency: EV_a loses 6.6667 kWh (final 17.3333, reserve 16) and EV_b loses 6.6667 kWh (final 13.3333, reserve 12). No charging is used since it cannot increase served energy. The discrete dispatch steps (4 kW / 3 kW) mean the full 14.4 kWh energy headroom cannot be realized; 12.0 kWh is the enumeration optimum.
